svg.title: toolbox.yml — tools I build with
svg.desc: Tools by category. ML & models: Vision-language models, LLMs, Fine-tuning, Embeddings, Rerankers, OCR, NumPy; Model serving: vLLM, AWS SageMaker, GPU inference, Amazon S3, IAM Roles Anywhere, Prometheus; Backend & data: Python, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Pydantic, JSON Schema, uv; Cloud & infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, k3s, DigitalOcean, AWS, MinIO; Security & supply chain: Linkerd mTLS, OpenBao, cert-manager, Kyverno, Sigstore Cosign, SBOM, SLSA, GitHub Actions; Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
